name: agent-bridge
description: Start, watch, continue, and cancel local Codex CLI and Claude Code tasks through a private, self-hosted MCP bridge. Not for redistribution.

interface.shortDescription: Start, watch, continue, and cancel local coding-agent tasks
interface.longDescription: A private connector to a single self-hosted Agent Bridge MCP service. It starts new Codex CLI or Claude Code tasks in allowlisted local repositories, reports status and output, continues a finished or waiting task's provider session, and cancels a running task. It never runs an arbitrary shell command and never bypasses Codex sandboxing or Claude Code permission controls.
defaultPrompt: Start a Codex task in <allowlisted repo path> to <task>.
Show the latest output for task <task id>.
